name: Lead Plating
levelText: alchemist 3, arcanist 2, cleric 2, druid 2, hunter 2, investigator 3, oracle 2, ranger 2, sorcerer 2, warpriest 2, witch 2, wizard 2
componentsText: V, S, F (an ounce of lead)
target: Target: a creature or object weighing up to 100 lbs./level
description:
You enclose the target in a thin sheath of lead. This doesn’t restrict
 the target’s movement or functionality, but protects it from the
 effects of radiation and prevents the penetration of many divination
 spells. The lead doesn’t coat the target’s equipment.
